security_justification.audit_integrity: The dependency refresh preserves frozen contract content and every audit event definition; npm integrity and exact lockfile comparison bind the artifact.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No product authorization changes. Existing maintainer CI credentials remain in their current context; Dependabot receives no additional permission.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The agent authors governance evidence before the lockfile implementation; review, CI and merge remain separate from authored assertions.
security_justification.concurrency: No runtime concurrency changes. A maintainer-owned branch avoids rewriting history underneath Dependabot automation.
security_justification.confidentiality: No credential value is copied, printed or committed; the restricted-secret policy for Dependabot remains enforced.
security_justification.cryptography: The existing npm artifact integrity field changes with the requested registry artifact; no product cryptographic code or key changes.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Verification reports package versions, drift and gate diagnostics; it does not expose credentials or user event data.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Existing analysis services execute in the normal maintainer PR context. No endpoint, integration scope or secret-access policy changes.
security_justification.fail_posture: The owning assessment, contract reuse, frozen-content checks and all required CI remain mandatory; no missing or skipped check is treated as a pass.
security_justification.lifecycle: Planning precedes the bounded implementation; independent review and CI precede merge, and archival is a separate later change.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Only the contract lockfile and this owning change directory may change; canonical source and generated contract paths remain immutable.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal information, event payload or privacy transformation is introduced by a development-tool lockfile update.
security_justification.resource_retention: Only normal local and CI dependency installation artifacts are created; no production data-retention or storage behavior changes.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No delivery, retry, redelivery or shutdown behavior changes; this update is restricted to the contract development toolchain.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Restricted credentials stay unavailable to Dependabot. The replacement uses the existing maintainer review and CI boundary without broadening it.
